(Japanese: シロガネ山修業編 《後編》 The Training Chapter (Part 2)) is the second special chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga taking place during and 's training on Mt. Silver. This chapter was first published in Pokémon the Comic on June 7, 2013, and was the result of Red and Pika respectively winning the human and Pokémon sections on the 2011 Netkun popularity poll.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
and Pika battle the wild and that kidnapped Pibu.
Due to their high level and being same species as Poli and Saur, Pika has trouble facing his opponents.
After calming down, Red has Pika defeat the two Pokémon and rescue Pibu.
Sometime later, Red reveals that the Super Rising Thunder technique Pibu used to defeat Pryce is actually named .
To help master the technique, Red lends his gloves.
Red and Pika go off to meet up with .

==Trivia==
reveals that the poster in his room was given to him from a friend overseas, revealing that Pokémon have different names in other locations.
Blue Sky Masters appear on Red's TV.
Several plot elements are revealed in this chapter.
Red's gloves are revealed to have an invisible lining to make it look like they're fingerless. This removes the plot hole as to why Red and Lt. Surge weren't shocked despite their fingers appearing to be unprotected from electricity.
The technique called "Super Rising Thunder" is actually the move .
The virus that would later grow into are discovered in the Mossdeep Space Center.
